title: "next monday" gives today when today is Monday
body: On a Monday, `tasker add "Plan week next monday"` sets the due date to today. "next monday" should never be today. Plain "monday" on a Monday can stay as today.

title: Labels with a hyphen are cut short
body: `tasker add "Write report @high-energy"` saves the label as `high`, and the task text becomes `Write report -energy`.

title: Filter `p1 | p2 & today` returns the wrong tasks
body: `tasker list --filter "p1 | p2 & today"` hides my p1 tasks that have no date. In Todoist, & binds tighter than |, so this should mean p1 OR (p2 AND today).

title: Completing a monthly task due on the 31st crashes
body: I have "Pay rent every month" due 2026-01-31. `tasker done` on it crashes with `ValueError: day 31 must be in range 1..28 for month 2`.

title: Labels like @deep-work get truncated
body: When I add a task with `@deep-work` the label is saved as `deep`.

title: Search tasks by text
body: Add `tasker search TEXT`. It should list open tasks whose content contains TEXT, ignoring case, in the same format as `tasker list`.

title: Can tasks repeat on weekdays only?
body: Do we support a task that repeats Monday to Friday but not at weekends?

title: Support "every weekday" recurrence
body: Add `every weekday` as a recurrence. Completing it should move the due date to the next Monday to Friday date, skipping Saturday and Sunday.

title: `tasker label` crashes when the label has an apostrophe
body: `tasker label "it's"` crashes with `sqlite3.OperationalError: near "s": syntax error`.

title: Deleting a project deletes tasks from other projects
body: I deleted my Work project and now `tasker list` looks broken. Some tasks show `#?` as the project. I think deleting a project damages other projects' tasks.

title: Filter for tasks due in the next N days
body: Add a filter term like `7 days` that matches tasks due from today up to and including N days from today. It should combine with the other terms, for example `7 days & @work`.

title: tasker list is slow with lots of tasks
body: Once I have a few thousand tasks, `tasker list` takes a long time. It feels like it gets slower the more tasks I have.

title: Export and import tasks as JSON
body: Add `tasker export FILE` and `tasker import FILE` so I can back up my tasks and move them to another machine. Importing into an empty database should give me back the same projects and tasks, with their priorities, due dates, labels and recurrence.

title: Undo the last completed task
body: Add `tasker undo` to reverse the last `tasker done`. I often complete the wrong task.

title: JSON output for tasker list
body: Add `tasker list --json` that prints the tasks as a JSON array, so I can pipe them into other tools. Each task should include id, content, priority, due, project, labels and recurrence. It should respect --filter and --project.

title: Subtasks
body: I want subtasks. `tasker add --parent 1 "Buy flour"` should add a subtask under task 1. `tasker list` should show subtasks indented under their parent.

title: Productivity stats
body: Add `tasker stats`. It should print two lines: `Completed today: N` and `Streak: N days`, where the streak is the number of days in a row, ending today, on which I completed at least one task.

title: Due times, not just dates
body: I want to say `Call Sam tomorrow at 5pm` and have the time saved. `tasker list` should show the time next to the date, for example `2026-03-05 17:00`. Tasks without a time should work as they do today.

title: HTTP API
body: Add a small JSON HTTP API so other apps can use tasker, started with `tasker serve --port 8080`. I need to list open tasks, add a task with quick add text, and complete a task. Standard library only. Please expose `tasker.api.make_server(store, host, port)` returning an `http.server.HTTPServer`, so it can be tested.

title: Rename a project
body: Add `tasker rename-project OLD NEW`.
